Frequently asked questions
What is Lovable and how does it work?
Lovable is an AI software engineer, which enables anyone to build for the web. Simply chat to instantly build websites and web apps, with no technical knowledge needed.
What is a credit?
How do I use credits in Lovable?
In addition to your credit balance, Pro and Business subscriptions include grants for building and hosting with Cloud.
For building, pricing varies by mode:
Default Mode:
credits vary based on task complexity
Plan Mode:
1 credit per message
Here are some example prompts and their cost:
User Prompt
Work Done
Credits
Make the button gray
Updates the button styles
0.50
Remove the footer
Removes the footer component
0.90
Add authentication with sign up and login
Adds authentication pages and logic, updates routes
1.20
Build me a landing page, use images
Creates a landing page with 3 generated images, theme, and 5 sections
1.70
You can see the cost of each message in the message history by hovering over the three dots of an message.
Do credits expire?
What happens to my credits if my subscription ends?
In very rare instances we had to close user accounts due to fraud or other breach of our Terms. In such cases, any remaining credits are deleted, unless otherwise required by the law.
Are credits refundable?
No. Credits aren't refundable or redeemable for cash or any other value.
What is included in free and paid plans?
Starting to build on Lovable is free.
How do I buy credits for a team, class, or community?
To keep any one person from using up the shared credits, workspace owners and admins can set a default monthly credit limit and per-member overrides.
Learn more about workspaces
This works the same for companies, classrooms, and communities. For large organizations, the Enterprise plan offers volume-based credit pricing.
Do you charge per seat or per user?
How much does it cost to run my app on Lovable?
Apps that reach significant visitor traffic and/or size may start incurring cost on top of the included grant, which is covered by your credit balance.
Learn more here
Why is the Business plan more expensive?
The higher price reflects the additional features Business adds on top of Pro for teams and larger organizations.
Who owns the projects and code?
Do you offer a student discount?
Yes, we offer a student discount for students with a valid student email. You can read more and claim your discount on
lovable.dev/students
. Make sure you are logged in with your university email address.
